info.name: KOMPTO API — Sandbox
info.description:
# KOMPTO API — Sandbox collection

Requests for the public KOMPTO invoicing API (FNE — *Facture Normalisée Électronique*, Côte d'Ivoire), organised in the order a new integration normally follows.

Built from the official integration guide **KOMPTO API GUIDE EN v5.2**.

---

## 1. Before you start

Open the collection's **Variables** tab and fill in:

| Variable | What to put |
|---|---|
| `apiKey` | The sandbox API key KOMPTO gave you. **It ships empty on purpose.** |
| `baseUrl` | Already set to the sandbox host `https://qa.kompto.com`. Leave it. |
| `establishment` / `pointOfSale` | Already set to the shared sandbox issuer (`PROGICI SARL` / `SIEGE`). Leave them as they are unless KOMPTO told you otherwise. |

> **If `POST /confirm` fails on `establishment` or `pointOfSale`**, your key is registered against a different sandbox account. These two values must belong to the account your API key was issued for — ask KOMPTO which establishment and point of sale to use, and put them in these variables. Everything else in the collection stays the same. `POST /verify` does not check them, so this only shows up at the confirmation step.
| `clientName`, `clientNCC`, `clientTelephone`, `clientEmail` | Your own test client. The defaults are the fictitious client used in the guide. |

Every request authenticates with `Authorization: Bearer {{apiKey}}`, inherited from the collection. You never have to paste the key into a request.

## 2. Sandbox vs production

The sandbox at `https://qa.kompto.com` is a **shared** test environment. Paths, headers and bodies are identical to production — only the host, the API key and the issuer change. Invoices issued here are real test FNEs with **no tax value**.

In the sandbox, invoices are always issued in the name of **PROGICI SARL** (the shared test issuer), not in your own company's name. That is expected. In production you switch `baseUrl` to the production host KOMPTO gives you, use your production key, and pass your own `establishment` / `pointOfSale`.

## 3. The two integration paths

**Path A — verify, then confirm (recommended while you build).**
`POST /verify` calculates and stores a draft, and returns a `komptoEntryId`. Nothing reaches the tax authority (DGI) yet. You show the amounts to the user, then `POST /confirm` to certify — or `DELETE /delete` to throw the draft away.

**Path B — create directly.**
`POST /create` does both in one call. Use it only once you are confident your amounts are always right: if the DGI rejects, the error body carries no `komptoEntryId`, so the pending entry left behind is hard to find.

Confirmation is **irreversible**. To correct a certified invoice you issue a credit note (`POST /createCreditNote`).

## 4. Variable chaining

Requests that return an identifier save it automatically into a collection variable, so you can run the folders top to bottom without copying anything by hand:

- `POST /verify` → `komptoEntryId`, `komptoItemId`
- `POST /confirm` and `POST /create` → `confirmedEntryId`, `creditNoteItemId`, `numberFNE`, `linkFNE`

## 5. Things that catch integrators out

- **Amounts you send are JSON numbers; amounts you get back are strings.** `"itemUnitPrice": 50000` goes out, `"itemUnitPrice": "50000"` comes back.
- **Decimal separators differ by direction.** Use a **dot** in requests (`655.957`). Responses use a **comma** (`"655,9570"`), French locale.
- **Percentages in responses carry a `%`** (`"18%"`, `"2,50%"`). Strip it before converting. In requests they are plain numbers (`10`).
- **Unused optional taxes must be `null` or omitted — never `0`.** `entryTaxTTC1Name` and `entryTaxTTC1Percent` travel as a pair: send both or neither.
- **`establishment` and `pointOfSale` are matched character for character by the DGI.** `"PDV1"` ≠ `"pdv1"` ≠ `"PDV 1"`. KOMPTO cannot pre-check them; a mismatch comes back as a DGI rejection.
- **Not every error is a 4xx.** Some failures return HTTP 200 with `"isSuccessful": false`. Check both.
- **Error bodies do not all have the same shape.** Some are a per-field `errors` object, some a `{ isSuccessful, message }` envelope, and the 404 on the getters is a bare JSON string (`"La commande n'existe pas."`) with no fields at all. Check the status code first, then the shape.
- **Error messages are in French, written for end users.** Display them rather than replacing them with a generic message.
- **`dateTimeFNE` uses the format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm`**, for example `"2026-09-16 09:40"` — space-separated, no seconds, no timezone suffix, Côte d'Ivoire local time. Parse it with that explicit pattern.
- **`getVerify` wraps its payload in `value`; the other endpoints are flat.** See folder 05.
- **Store `komptoItemId` for every line.** You cannot issue a credit note later without it.

item.name: 01 · Authentication
item.description: There is no dedicated login endpoint. Authentication is a header on every call...

request.description: Smoke test for your API key. 401 = invalid, 404 bare string = OK.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 401) { console.error('KOMPTO: the key in {{apiKey}} is missing or invalid.'); } else { console.log('KOMPTO: key accepted (HTTP ' + pm.response.code + ' — the id simply does not exist).'); }
pm.test('API key is accepted (anything but 401)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'HTTP 401 means the key is missing or invalid').to.not.eql(401); });

exec: pm.test('Status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { var body = pm.response.json(); var invoice = body && body.value ? body.value : body; if (invoice && invoice.komptoEntryId) { pm.collectionVariables.set('komptoEntryId', invoice.komptoEntryId); } if (invoice && Array.isArray(invoice.items) && invoice.items.length > 0) { pm.collectionVariables.set('komptoItemId', invoice.items[0].komptoItemId); } }
pm.test('Status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Business result is successful', function () { pm.expect(body.isSuccessful, body.message || '').to.not.eql(false); }); var invoice = body && body.value ? body.value : body; if (invoice && invoice.numberFNE) { pm.collectionVariables.set('confirmedEntryId', invoice.komptoEntryId); pm.collectionVariables.set('numberFNE', invoice.numberFNE); pm.collectionVariables.set('linkFNE', invoice.linkFNE); if (Array.isArray(invoice.items) && invoice.items.length > 0) { pm.collectionVariables.set('creditNoteItemId', invoice.items[0].komptoItemId); } pm.collectionVariables.set('komptoEntryId', ''); pm.collectionVariables.set('komptoItemId', ''); } }

item.name: 05 · Retrieval and status
item.description: Two read endpoints: getVerify (pending) and getElectronicInvoice (certified)...

request.description: Reads back pending draft. Wrapped in value.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('komptoEntryId')) { throw new Error('komptoEntryId is empty. Run POST /verify first.'); }
pm.test('Status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

if (pm.response.code === 404) { console.warn('KOMPTO 404:', pm.response.text()); } else if (pm.response.code === 200) { var body = pm.response.json(); var invoice = body && body.value ? body.value : body; console.log('draft', invoice.komptoEntryId, '— total due', invoice.entryTotalDue); }
pm.test('Status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

if (pm.response.code === 404) { console.warn('KOMPTO 404:', pm.response.text()); } else if (pm.response.code === 200) { var body = pm.response.json(); var invoice = body && body.value ? body.value : body; console.log('numberFNE =', invoice.numberFNE); }

item.name: 06 · Credit notes
item.description: A certified FNE cannot be cancelled. Credit note reduces quantity...

exec: pm.test('Status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Business result is successful', function () { pm.expect(body.isSuccessful, body.message || '').to.not.eql(false); }); var note = body && body.value ? body.value : body; if (note && note.numberFNE) { console.log('credit note numberFNE =', note.numberFNE); } }
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('komptoEntryId')) { throw new Error('komptoEntryId is empty. Run POST /verify first.'); }
pm.test('Status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

if (pm.response.code === 200 || pm.response.code === 404) { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Draft was actually deleted', function () { pm.expect(body.isSuccessful, body.message || '').to.be.true; }); if (body.isSuccessful === true) { pm.collectionVariables.set('komptoEntryId', ''); pm.collectionVariables.set('komptoItemId', ''); } }
